name: L298N Motor Driver
fullName: L298N Dual H-Bridge High-Power DC & Stepper Motor Driver Module
tagline: Dual H-Bridge driver capable of bidirectional speed control for two DC motors or one stepper
description: The L298N Motor Driver module contains an ST L298N dual full-bridge driver chip with onboard 5V regulator and heat sink. It can independently control the direction and speed (via PWM) of two DC motors (up to 2A per channel) or drive a 4-wire bipolar stepper motor.

specs.driverChip: L298N Dual H-Bridge IC with flyback diodes
specs.onboardRegulator: 78M05 5V regulator (active when jumper 5V-EN is closed, input <= 12V)

pinout.name: 5V Logic
pinout.desc: 5V output (if 5V enable jumper ON) or 5V input (if jumper OFF)

pinout.name: Speed Motor A
pinout.desc: PWM pin for speed control of Motor A

pinout.name: Dir Motor A
pinout.desc: Direction control inputs for Motor A

pinout.name: Dir Motor B
pinout.desc: Direction control inputs for Motor B

pinout.name: Speed Motor B
pinout.desc: PWM pin for speed control of Motor B

wiringNote: Always connect the GND pin of the L298N to the Arduino GND pin (Common Ground) or control signals will fail.
libraryName: No external library required (uses analogWrite for PWM and digitalWrite for direction)
commonMistakes: Leaving the 5V-EN jumper installed when powering with >12V (overheats onboard regulator)
Forgetting common ground with the microcontroller
